## What this does, and what it deliberately does not

**Runs today.** `expire_paper_commands()` walks every paper account, expires
orders past `expires_at`, releases the `cash_ceiling` each of them had
reserved, and expires plans still sitting in `pending_approval`. Without it
reserved cash is never returned and the desk slowly runs out of buying power
against orders that can never fill.

**Does not fill orders, on purpose.** `complete_paper_order` will only accept
a fill whose `snapshot_id` names a row in `paper_book_evidence` whose
`token_id` equals the order's `token_id`. `book_snapshots` stores ONE
unlabelled book per band and has no `token_id` column, so a NO-side order
cannot be evidenced from it without asserting which of the two tokens the
stored book belongs to. That assertion would be a guess written into the
ledger as proof. Add `token_id` to `book_snapshots` (P0.3 knows it at fetch
time) and the filler becomes buildable on real evidence.

**Does not settle positions, on purpose.** `settle_paper_inventory` demands a
`paper_resolution_evidence` row carrying BOTH a Gamma payload (`closed`,
`umaResolutionStatus=resolved`) and a CLOB payload (`closed`,
`accepting_orders=false`, exactly one winning token). The Gamma endpoint is
the one P0.5 uses and is known good; the CLOB market endpoint is not used
anywhere in AD4 yet and has not been verified against the live venue. Adding
it unverified would produce evidence rows that `settle_paper_inventory`
rejects - or worse, accepts.
